name: worktender-watch
description: Watches the worktender fleet: a status line count, a band when a worker reports done or blocked, and a toast (or, opted in, a turn) when one does.

wake.title: On a new report
wake.description: toast shows a toast and the band; turn also starts a turn so Claude verifies it (spends tokens without you asking).

scope.title: Which workers
scope.description: repo watches the repository the session started in; all watches every repository herdr has workers in.

prFeedback.title: Route PR feedback to workers
prFeedback.description: Each poll, run `worktender pr-feedback`: tell the idle worker on a branch about new reviews and failing checks on its open PR (counts, logins and check names only). One gh call per branch.

prFeedbackRounds.title: PR feedback rounds per PR
prFeedbackRounds.description: How many notices one PR's worker gets before further reviews and failing checks go to you as a toast instead of to the worker. 0 sends none.

refocus.title: Refocus workers after compaction
refocus.description: In a worker's session, after Claude Code compacts it, add the goal chain from `worktender refocus` (tracking issue, issue and its acceptance criteria) to its context. Two gh calls per compaction. Also, where the worker's role sets a refocus interval, on the prompts `worktender refocus --if-due` says are due.

intervalSeconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
intervalSeconds.description: How often to run `worktender ls --reports --json`. It takes about 20 ms.

worktender.title: worktender binary
worktender.description: Path to worktender, or the name to find on PATH.
